Workflow files the nested view's parser is tested on, as published (MIT license):

- `rnaseq-main.nf`, `rnaseq-workflow.nf`: `main.nf` and `workflows/rnaseq/main.nf` of
  [nf-core/rnaseq](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq) 3.27.0.
- `quantify_pseudo_alignment.nf`, `bam_stringtie_merge.nf`: subworkflows of
  [nf-core/modules](https://github.com/nf-core/modules), at the commit of `src/registry/nfcore/catalog.json`.
